description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 3], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and Zenith Mode: Serafie (Wind) to the user
Zenith Mode: Serafie (Wind): En-Wind Damage +20%, Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases 2 Wind abilities with Wind Damage +10% to party (max 2 chases)
Zenith Mode: Serafie (Wind): Dualcast Wind, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Wind Rhapsody+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Zenith Mode: Serafie (Wind): +1500 max HP & Astra to user

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
